declare

begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 BEGIN
 SELECT warehouse_id INTO temp_present_wh
 FROM active_products
 WHERE unit_id = :unit_id
 AND product_code = :product_code
 AND aliquot = :aliquot
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND stock_state in ('AV','TR')
 AND rownum = 1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 show_error_dist('0313');
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 DECLARE
 temp_status varchar2(5); 
 temp_wh varchar2(20);
 BEGIN 
 select wtd.batch_id, wth.to_warehouse, wth.batch_status
 into :batch_id, temp_to_warehouse, temp_status
 from wh_trans_dtl wtd, wh_trans_hdr wth
 where unit_id = :WH_TRANS_DTL.unit_id
 and wth.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and wtd.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and wtd.batch_id = wth.batch_id
 and product_code = :product_code
 and aliquot = :aliquot
 and receive_date is null
 and receive_user is null ;
 IF temp_status = 'OPEN' THEN
 BEGIN
 select substr(code_desc,1,20) into temp_wh
 from vserv_master 
 where code_type = 'LTYPE'
 and code = substr(:batch_id,3,1)
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate);
 EXCEPTION 
 when others then
 null; 
 END;
 show_error_dist('9927','Batch ' || :batch_id || ' is open' ||' at ' || temp_wh );
 END IF; 
 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 IF :global.warehouse = temp_present_wh THEN
 show_error_dist('9926');
 ELSE 
 show_error_dist('9925'); 
 END IF;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 END ;
 IF :batch_id is not null THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT code_desc INTO temp_warehouse_name
 FROM vserv_master 
 WHERE code_type = 'LTYPE'
 AND code = temp_to_warehouse
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 IF temp_to_warehouse != :GLOBAL.warehouse THEN
 show_error_dist('9923',temp_warehouse_name);
 END IF;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION 
 WHEN form_trigger_failure THEN
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 WHEN others THEN
 message('Contact I.S. ' || sqlerrm);
 handle_error;
END;

Trigger.Name: CHECK_NO_LOCATION
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_device VARCHAR2(1);
 v_local_time date;
begin
 v_local_time := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate); -- Added by Kishore on 05/05/2012. IM 8591
 
 execute_trigger('pre_location');
 check_package_failure;
 --
 -- set storage_class
 --
 if :loca_0.storage_class = 'AD'
 then
 if :loca_0.blood_type = '40'
 then
 :loca_0.storage_class := 'AU';
 else
 :loca_0.storage_class := 'DR';
 end if;
 elsif :loca_0.blood_type = 'PO'
 then
 :loca_0.storage_class := 'PO';
 elsif (:loca_0.blood_type = '71' and :global.code_scheme = 'C') or 
--Codes for EMERGENCY blood type for code 128
 (:loca_0.blood_type in ('92','48','03','59','14','70','25','81','P3','A3','B3','C3') 
 and :global.code_scheme = 'I') 
 then
 :loca_0.storage_class := 'ER';
 end if;
 default_value('','GLOBAL.save_location');
 :loca_0.chapter_id := :global.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.skip_warehouse := 'N';
 --
 -- find if product does not require physical device
 --
 begin
 select distinct device_type
 into temp_device
 from product_storage
 where chapter_id = :loca_0.chapter_id
 and warehouse_id = nvl(:s_warehouse_id,warehouse_id)
 and product_type = :loca_0.product_type
 --and sysdate between effective_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate); -- Commented by Kishore on 05/05/2012. IM 8591
 and v_local_time between effective_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10); -- Added by Kishore on 05/05/2012. IM 8591
 exception
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 temp_device := '';
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 temp_device := '';
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
-- HCL if :loca_0.blood_type in ('71','PO')
 if ((:loca_0.blood_type = 'PO') or
 (:loca_0.blood_type = '71' and :global.code_scheme = 'C') or 
--Codes for EMERGENCY blood type for code 128
 (:loca_0.blood_type in ('92','48','03','59','14','70','25','81','P3','A3','B3','C3') 
 and :global.code_scheme = 'I') )
 or temp_device = 'N'
 then
 :s_warehouse_id := '';
 :GLOBAL.location_id := 'NONE';
 :m_tray_id := 'NONE';
 GO_ITEM('m_tray_id');
 execute_trigger('post_location');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 --
 -- location required, set flag for storage by Rh
 --
 begin
 select nvl(order_abo_group, abo_code)
 into :loca_0.blood_type
 from vserv_abo va
 where exists
 (select 'x'
 from vserv_product_types vp
 where vp.product_type = :loca_0.product_type
 and (vp.ship_any_rh = 'Y'
 or vp.abo_only = 'Y'))
 and va.abo_code = :loca_0.blood_type
 AND rownum < 2
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate); -- Commented by Kishore on 05/05/2012. IM 8591
 and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10); -- Added by Kishore on 05/05/2012. IM 8591
 
 :loca_0.ship_any_rh := 'Y';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :loca_0.ship_any_rh := 'N';
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- Check for default of warehouse
 --
 if :s_warehouse_id is not null
 then
 :GLOBAL.skip_warehouse := 'Y';
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif substr(:GLOBAL.save_location,13) =
 :loca_0.storage_class||
 :loca_0.Product_type||
 :loca_0.blood_type
 then
 :s_warehouse_id := substr(:GLOBAL.save_location,1,1);
 end if;
 end if;
end;

procedure check_for_interdictions(p_unit_id in VARCHAR2,
 p_coll_date in date,
 p_product_code in VARCHAR2,
 p_aliquot in number) is
 temp_count number;
 temp_label_dats date;
 temp_label VARCHAR2(4);
begin
 begin
 select nvl(label_dats,sysdate-1000000), system_label_decision
 into temp_label_dats, temp_label
 from components
 where unit_id = p_unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and coll_date = p_coll_date
 and product_code = p_product_code
 and component_prefix = p_aliquot;
 end;
 --
 -- Check if product is in quaratine
 --
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from quarantine_products
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = p_unit_id
 and product_code = p_product_code
 and aliquot = p_aliquot;
 show_error_dist('3728'); -- Product is placed on quarantine
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- Check if product is in discard
 --
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from discard_products
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = p_unit_id
 and product_code = p_product_code
 and aliquot = p_aliquot;
 show_error_dist('6300'); -- Product is already discard
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- check for component interdictions
 --
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from component_interdictions
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = p_unit_id
 and coll_date = p_coll_date
 and product_code = p_product_code
 and insert_dats > temp_label_dats;
 if temp_count > 0
 then
 show_error_dist('3721'); -- component interdicted
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 --
 -- Check if unit has interdictions
 --
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from unit_interdictions ui, valid_interdictions_lab vi
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = p_unit_id
 and coll_date = p_coll_date
 and ui.inter_code = vi.inter_code
 and vi.inter_type != 'I'
 and (vi.inter_type != 'B' or temp_label not in ('40','71'))
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)
 and insert_dats > temp_label_dats;
 if temp_count > 0
 then
 show_error_dist('3722'); -- unit interdicted
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;

declare
 temp_code number;
 temp_msg VARCHAR2(80);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error_dist('0213');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error_dist('0214');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error_dist('0216');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error_dist('0204');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error_dist('0217');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error_dist('0218');
 elsif error_code = 40209 -- invalid entry format
 then
 show_error_dist('0246');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error_dist('0000');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0601');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026,0)
 then
 declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(20);
 begin
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2))='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error_dist('0251',disp_format_mask);
 show_error_dist('0251',GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 end;
 elsif error_code = 50025 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0509');
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error_dist('0220');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error_dist('0331');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;
 else -- unhandled Forms errors
 message('FRMS ' || to_char(error_code) || ':' || error_text);
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;
